sloka: नैवं राक्षसशार्दूल त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः ।राजशास्त्रव्यपेतो हि मार्गः संसेव्यते त्वया ।। ५.५८.१४६ ।।।।
transliteration: naivaṁ rākṣasaśārdūla tyajyatāmeṣa niścayaḥ ।rājaśāstravyapeto hi mārgaḥ saṁsevyate tvayā ।। 5.58.146 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibhishana, a tiger among demons, asked Ravana to give up his decision as it was a forbidden course according to the science of royal polity.
